description: Constellation definitions for Phase 8 gold lens tracing puzzles

constellations.name: The Signal
constellations.description: A beginner triangle — three club nodes at 90° angles. The first constellation every agent traces.

constellations.name: The Intercept
constellations.description: Four nodes in a diamond shape. Two clubs, two diamonds (need pink lens to transform before gold can connect).

constellations.name: The Dead Drop
constellations.description: Five-node zigzag chain. Three clubs, two spades. Spades need silver lens amplification before gold can connect.
